items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: he didn’t really make his money until he found Elvis, who was singing black music.

ctx.x: And recording some great black artists, but he didn’t really make his money until he found Elvis, who was singing black music.
Black music. As a matter of fact I was recording with RCA Victor that week that, I’m trying to think of his name, went down, the sign presser—
